ACTION: propose_fix

DETAIL: ```python
def pancake_sort(nums):
    arr_len = len(nums)
    while arr_len > 1:
        # Find the index of the maximum element in the unsorted portion
        mi = nums.index(max(nums[:arr_len]))
        
        # Flip the array from the start to the position of the maximum element
        nums = nums[:mi+1][::-1] + nums[mi+1:]
        
        # Flip the entire unsorted portion to move the maximum element to the end
        nums = nums[:arr_len][::-1] + nums[arr_len:]
        
        # Decrease the length of the unsorted portion
        arr_len -= 1
    
    return nums
```
